# @ruqinhu/dsh-weixin-link
English | 中文

The Weixin (iLink) channel for DeepSeek Harness:
receives messages, and delivers turn results withou

t the model having to remember to
send them.
## 1. The constraint
| Constraint | Consequence |

| Every send must carry a `context_token` | a token can only come from an inbound message |
| No tok

en can be minted | a quiet night parks the 07:00 report until the owner speaks |
| A fallback channe

l would hide failure | no fallback; parked text is replayed, never rerouted |
| Over-long payloads c
an return a message id and still not arrive | the 2,200-char cap is enforced in code, not trusted to
message id and still not arrive | the 2,200-char cap is enforced in code, not trusted to the model |
## 2. Which turns are delivered
| `source.kind` | Origin | Delivered |

| `schedule` | cron task | ✅ |
| `weixin-link` | owner messaged from Weixin | ✅ |
| `user` | typed i

n terminal / web UI | ❌ answer already on screen |
| `runtime-context` / `skill-catalog` / `time-con

text` | injected context | ❌ not speech |
| `compact-checkpoint` / `provider` / `fallback` | compact
ion, title generation | ❌ internal noise |

Only the **first** user message names the origin: every turn is followed by injected
context, so the
last one would classify every turn as context and deliver nothing.
## 3. Mechanisms
| Problem | Decision | Rejected alternative | Cost paid |
| Who delivers | the channel subscribes to `session/event` and sends on `turn/end` | telling the mod
el "you must call `weixin_push`" — it answered in-session and delivered nothing, pushed meta-comment

ary, and shipped errors as reports | the model cannot choose silence, except via `[SILENT]` |
| Dupl
icate sends | identical text within 10 min counts as delivered; a manual `weixin_push` stands auto-d
elivery down | an LLM "is this worth it" gate: a round trip per message, and a silent "don't send" i

s indistinguishable from a crash | duplicates outside the window still go out |
| Empty turns | `本次无
产出（timestamp）` | silence: "ran and failed" looks like "never ran" | one message that may say nothing

|
| Failed turns | `⚠️ 回合未完成（reason，timestamp）：本次没有可投递的内容。`, at most one per session per hour | sen
ding the partial text: a fragment reads like an answer; skipping: a crashed 07:00 report looks like

a day with no schedule | the hourly floor is in memory, so a restart can add one |
| Images | downlo
aded from `…/c2c/download?encrypted_query_param=…`, decrypted with **AES-128-ECB**, saved to `inbox/
`, and the message names the files for `read_image` | dropping them silently: on 2026-11-04 an image
was sent twice and neither the agent nor the log saw anything, so the owner gave up ("不改了就这样吧") | o
ne download per attachment inside a background task, and a decrypt failure degrades to the placehold

er |
| Other media | folded into a placeholder the agent can act on (`（收到 1 个文件…）`), with the wire f
ield skeleton appended to `inbound-media.log` | pretending to have read a voice note or a file: the

model would answer about content nobody read | content still unread — the placeholder says so |
| Fi
les | downloaded, decrypted, saved to `inbox/`, and the message names the path for `read` or `bash`
| dropping them: a document the owner sent would be invisible to the agent | an unidentified type is

saved as `.bin` instead of being guessed |
[该节后续省略]
## 4. Failure handling
| Class | Action | Why not the alternative |

| stale token | park, do not retry | only a new inbound can mint a token |
| rate limited | back off

30/60/120 s, then park | dropping after the ladder looks like "never scheduled" |
| other | one imm

ediate retry, then give up | more retries turn a blip into a queue stall |
| no `context_token` at a

ll (auto-delivery) | drop, do not park | replaying a week-old report is worse than dropping it |
| r
eplayed entry fails | keep it, never re-park | a second file for the same text means every copy is s
ed entry fails | keep it, never re-park | a second file for the same text means every copy is sent |
## 5. Measured
| Item | Result |

| Unit tests | 248 across 21 files; `tsc --noEmit` clean |
| Delivery round trip | inbound 10:00:04

→ turn completed 10:00:24 → `ok msgid=7523202391886746000` in the same second |
| Watchdog | heartbe

at advances every round, `restarts: 0` across a 14-hour run |
| Receipts | one JSONL line per attemp
t, keyed by the operator's local day |

**5.1 An outage, as the trace recorded it.** Quota exhaustion (`429 AccountQuotaExceeded`),
two cons
ecutive builds on the same channel:
| Time (UTC) | Build | Behaviour |

| 10:40:29 | old | `skip … turn=304 reason=not-completed` |
| 10:42:31 | old | `skip … turn=305 reas

on=not-completed` |
| 10:44:34 | old | `skip … turn=306 reason=not-completed` |
| 10:46:33 | new | `

send … turn=307 kind=failure len=44` → `ok msgid=7522972414050248000` |
| 10:46+ | new | further not
ices held back: `skip … reason=failure-notice-rate-limited` |
Four minutes of silence became one line on the phone saying the run did not finish.
## 6. Open questions
| Question | Current state |

| Token refresh | cannot be done by the plugin; ~12 h without an inbound message parks sends |
| Rec

ipients | one poll loop, one recipient; multi-account needs a routing layer |
| Replay concurrency |

serial; per-entry locking would be needed |
| Failure-notice floor | in memory; persisting costs a

write per failure |
| Media / rich cards | none — text is the only payload whose failure is observab

le here |
| Watchdog false positives | a debugger pause or long GC looks like a stall; restart is ha

rmless but recorded |
| Outbox validation | none at write time; bad entries are skipped on read and

ut recorded |
| Outbox validation | none at write time; bad entries are skipped on read and logged |
## 7. Compatibility
| Item | Value |

| DSH | `0.2.2-rc.1` (peer dependencies pinned) |
| Runtime | Node 22+, no native modules |
| Requir

ed services | `tools`, `credentials`, `sessionController`; `agents` optional |
| Payload | text out;

inbound text, images, files and voice |
| Voice transcription | needs `python3` + `faster_whisper`
+ `pilk` on the host; `sttCommand` overrides the helper |
